meta.name: writing-guidelines
meta.description: Review docs/prose for Writing Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my docs", "check writing style", "audit prose", "review docs voice and tone", or "check this page against the writing handbook".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查文档是否符合写作规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保文档遵循统一的写作指南
copy.tagline_en: Check docs for writing guidelines compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure docs follow a writing handbook

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先联网获取最新的写作规范，再读取你指定的文档，逐条对照规范检查，最后用“文件:行号”的简洁格式输出所有不合规的地方。
howto.when: 当你说“review my docs”、“check writing style”等，或提出“audit prose”等审阅要求时触发。

say.text: 请检查我的文档写作风格是否合规
say.note: Claude 会获取规范并审查该文档。

say.text: 审查 docs 文件夹下的所有文件
say.note: Claude 会按规范逐文件检查。

say.text: 对我的博客初稿做一次文字审查
say.note: Claude 会对照最新指南给出不合规清单。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude fetches the latest writing guidelines from a remote URL, reads your specified files, checks them against every rule, and outputs findings in a terse file:line format.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'review my docs', 'check writing style', 'audit prose', or similar requests to review against the writing handbook.

say_en.text: Check if my document's writing style complies
say_en.note: Claude fetches guidelines and reviews the file.

say_en.text: Review all files in the docs folder
say_en.note: Claude checks each file against the rules.

say_en.text: Audit my blog draft for writing issues
say_en.note: Claude lists non-compliant spots per the latest guide.
